_comment: Reference page — every section the template can render, with a sample of each copy field. Noindexed and excluded from the sitemap. Copy this file as the starting point for a new page, then delete any section you do not need (hub, benefits, why, faqs and map are all optional).

head.title: Sample City Pest Control | Breeze Pest Control — Free Quotes
head.description: Meta description goes here — roughly 150 to 160 characters, written for the click, ending with the phone number. Call (850) 400-8445 for a free quote.

hero.description: Hero description. This field accepts Markdown links, so an internal link like [our guarantee](/#guarantee) renders as a real link exactly where the copy places it.
hero.imageAlt: Breeze Pest Control truck and technician on a job in Sample City, Florida
hero.offer: ★ Summer Special — $100 OFF Your Initial Service

quote.title: Get a Free Quote in Sample City
quote.intro: Tell us what's bugging you. A member of our local Pensacola team will reach out during business hours — no pressure, no obligation.

hub.heading: Choose Your Service
hub.description: The hub block renders only when the page has children — remove this key entirely on pages that have none.

cards.title: General Pest Defense
cards.imageAlt: Cockroach treated under the General Pest Defense plan
cards.description: Card description. Auto-generated cards pull this from the child page's meta description.

cards.title: Termite Inspections
cards.imageAlt: Inspector checking a crawl space for termite damage
cards.description: Card image and title come from the child page's hubCard block when one is present.

cards.title: Rodent & Wildlife
cards.imageAlt: Technician sealing an exterior entry point
cards.description: Declared cards like these let a hub link somewhere real before its child pages exist.

benefits.heading: Benefits Heading Goes Here
benefits.subheading: Benefits subheading — two lines of supporting copy. This field also accepts links, for example an external source like the [FDACS pest control licence lookup](https://www.fdacs.gov/).
benefits.imageAlt: Insects commonly treated by Breeze Pest Control

bullets.title: First Bullet Title
bullets.text: Bullet body copy. The title renders as a bold uppercase lead-in above the text, with a blue checkmark to the left.

bullets.title: Second Bullet Title
bullets.text: Three bullets per block is the standard. Bullet text accepts links too.

bullets.title: Third Bullet Title
bullets.text: Image sits on the LEFT for the Benefits block — the Why block below mirrors it.

why.heading: Why Heading Goes Here
why.subheading: Why subheading. Same structure as Benefits, mirrored — image on the right, paper-coloured background to separate the two blocks visually.
why.imageAlt: Branded Breeze Pest Control service truck

bullets.title: First Bullet Title
bullets.text: Benefits and Why images must be unique per page across a whole batch — no reuse between pages in the same month.

bullets.title: Second Bullet Title
bullets.text: Both blocks close with a gold quote CTA and the phone number.

bullets.title: Third Bullet Title
bullets.text: Bullet count is not fixed by the template, but the copy format is three.

faqs.a: Answer copy. Links inside FAQ answers stay exactly where the copy puts them — they render as real links for users, and get stripped to plain text only in the FAQPage JSON-LD.
Three FAQs per page is the standard from the copy format. The template will render any number.
Remove the faqs key entirely and both the FAQ section and its FAQPage schema drop out of the page.

map.description: Map description. Variant 'location' embeds an area map from the query above — use it on county and city pages. Variant 'gbp' embeds the Google Business Profile instead — use it on service pages.
map.title: Breeze Pest Control Sample City service area map

final.heading: Sample City, Protected.
final.description: Two minutes online. A callback from a real local. First visit within 48 hours. No surprises — ever.
